title: Book 7 — Polymnia, Chapter 133
paragraphs: Such was the oath taken by the Greeks. But Xerxes had not sent heralds to Athens or Sparta to demand earth, for this reason: when Darius earlier had sent men for this very purpose, the Athenians threw those who made the demand into the pit and the Spartans threw them into a well, telling them to take earth and water from there and carry them to the king. For this reason Xerxes did not send envoys to make this demand. What evil came upon the Athenians in consequence of this treatment of the heralds, I cannot say — except that their land and city were laid waste; but I do not think this happened for that reason.
